card.title: DANZIG
card.text: The Free City of Danzig was captured by German forces at the start of the war.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Westerplatte in the harbor of Danzig was one of the first battles in Germany's invasion of Poland, marking the start of World War II in Europe. Germany held the city until at the end of the war when it was liberated by Polish and Soviet forces.
